countedBy: lane (opus) from the rectified crops, 2026-11-07, before comparing with the model; ribbon convention: each ribbon window is one opening, the ground-storey glazing counts once per run between piers or columns. Blind recount welcome.

facades.name: Kingsfordweg front, north section (w03)
facades.note: Ground storey: glazing between nine dark piers, one run north of the first pier, the two-storey hall at the south end and the run south of it (11). Second band: nine ribbon windows (none over the hall) and the hall's upper tier above the floor-slab line at about 4 m (10); the two upper rows eleven each (the first one narrower).

facades.name: Kingsfordweg front, south section (w04)
facades.note: Ground storey: glazing set back behind round columns, six runs north of the passage and three south of it (9). The lowest window row is half hidden by the street trees (null); the two upper rows eighteen square windows each.
